svg.aria-label: Featured projects: Microtiss Confect ERP; Hermes Suite; Secured Banking Infra; The Hive; Smart Home IoT; Windows Server Lab
svg.text: Full-cycle industrial ERP for a textile manufacturer:
supplier orders, approvals, stock, production, invoices and
payments, shared across teams with granular RBAC.
MERN e-commerce platform with catalogue, cart,
checkout, orders and PDF invoices, now being matured
Microservices banking app on a private OpenStack cloud
in GNS3: dual pfSense, VLANs, Kafka, KYC with JWT/RBAC
Trading platform backend serving the web client through
fully authenticated REST endpoints, with Swagger docs
Led a team of three to ship a mobile app streaming live
Arduino sensor data and controlling LEDs from the phone.
Windows Server roles (FTP, DNS, DHCP) with Active
